nodes.label: broker compose service (local build)
nodes.rationale: Builds from the local Dockerfile by default; the prebuilt ghcr.io/ustalabs/supermux:latest image is commented out as an opt-in to skip the build. tty/stdin_open are kept so `docker compose exec broker claude login` device-flow OAuth works without extra flags.

nodes.label: mux-state and claude-auth named volumes
nodes.rationale: Broker DB, push keys and session state (mux-state) plus Claude Code OAuth tokens (claude-auth) are persisted in named volumes so `claude login` and paired devices survive container restarts.

nodes.label: ./workspace bind mount
nodes.rationale: Mounted at /workspace inside every spawned agent session so containerized agents edit real host repositories.
